name: acs-cymru-asset-tracking
description: Aber, the shopfloor data platform (Supabase BaaS + standalone TimescaleDB)

scripts.//test:lib: Explicit file paths, NOT `node --test scripts/lib/`: the directory form's discovery behaves differently on Windows and reports the directory itself as one failing test.
scripts.test:lib: node --test scripts/lib/flow-shape.test.mjs scripts/lib/gateway-converge.test.mjs scripts/lib/mosquitto-credentials.test.mjs scripts/lib/mosquitto-dynsec.test.mjs scripts/lib/orphaned-accounts.test.mjs scripts/lib/service-jwt.test.mjs
scripts.//test:db: The database suites against a THROWAWAY Postgres, not the live stack. They default to port 54322, which is where the dev loop forwards the live Supabase database -- and their committed fixtures leave permanent rows in the append-only digital_thread. Needs Docker and nothing else; --keep leaves the container up.
scripts.//test:db:history: The same chain, replayed a SECOND time over a copy of the dev cluster's rows. An empty database cannot exercise an assertion about accumulated data: 0120 asserted over every row in digital_thread, which is true of nothing and false of any deployed stack, and it passed every suite before failing db-init four times on k3d. Read-only against the live stack. Run it for any migration carrying an UPDATE, a DELETE, a new CHECK or a self-check that counts.
scripts.//test:py: Every Python suite in a LANE, discovered from the tree rather than listed. scripts/python-suites.mjs says which lane each suite is in and why; the runner refuses to run at all if a test_*.py in the tree has no lane, which is what stopped twenty of them running in no job anywhere (#147). `unit` needs nothing. `db` needs the migrated Postgres and is what test:db runs against its throwaway container. `stack` needs a running stack: `npm run dev:test` on k3d, which is what CI runs.
scripts.//keys: The two principal-bearing service keys (issue #101). check is safe to run anywhere and exits non-zero when one is near expiry; rotate re-signs both in place and names the containers to restart.
scripts.//dev: The development loop on a local k3d cluster (deploy/k8s/README.md, The development loop). up: cluster if absent, cert-manager, the nine images built and imported, helm upgrade --install, every hook and rollout waited for, helm test. test: validate.py and the stack lane from the host through port-forwards on the ports the suites default to. reset: a blank stack on the same cluster and images.
